text: I received a WhatsApp message claiming to be from my bank. It asked me to click a link and enter my OTP because my account would otherwise be blocked.
Got an SMS saying my electricity bill is unpaid and power will be disconnected tonight unless I click http://pay-bill-now.xyz/abc
A caller said he was from customer care of my bank and asked for the OTP to stop a fraudulent transaction. I shared it and Rs 25,000 was debited.
A buyer on OLX sent a QR code and said scan it to receive payment. When I entered my UPI PIN, Rs 8,000 was sent to buyer.pay@ybl.
There is an unauthorised transaction of Rs 45,000 on my debit card that I never made. The bank account was debited at an ATM in another city.
I ordered a phone from an Instagram shop, paid Rs 15,000 and the seller blocked me. I never received the product.
I joined a Telegram group promising double returns on stock trading. I invested 2 lakh rupees and now they ask for tax before withdrawal.
A recruiter offered me a work from home job and asked for a registration fee of Rs 3,000 before sending the offer letter.
I found out a loan was taken in my name using my PAN card and Aadhaar documents without my knowledge.
My Instagram account was hacked, the password changed and I am locked out. Someone logged in from another country.
Someone made a fake profile on Facebook with my name and photo and is asking my friends for money pretending to be me.
I installed an APK sent by a caller and gave remote access through AnyDesk. Now I see strange activity on my phone.
All the files on our office computer are encrypted and a note demands a ransom in bitcoin to decrypt them.
A stranger recorded a video call and is threatening to leak my video unless I pay. This is blackmail.
A classmate keeps sending me abusive and threatening messages and is trolling me on every post. This harassment is constant.
I met someone on a dating app who built a relationship for months, then asked me to pay customs charges for a gift.
I deposited USDT into a crypto exchange recommended by a friend online and now the wallet shows a balance I cannot withdraw.
Something strange happened online.
I got an email from support@secure-netbank.co asking me to verify my login on www.netbank-verify.com or my account will be suspended.
Our customer database was leaked and posted online; the data breach exposed phone numbers of users.
